finding: No Rules-of-Hooks violations found anywhere: every component destructures the reactive proxy at the top of the function body before loops/conditionals/early-returns; .map bodies use pre-destructured consts or pure registry calls.
RangeField <input type=range> has no accessible name (label is a sibling span, no htmlFor/aria-label) — an unlabeled slider; will fail the axe/WCAG gate.
Field renders label as a bare <span> with no htmlFor; SelectField/NumberField/SwitchField controls hand AT no programmatic label (Switch line 155 same).
Gene <Input> has only a placeholder, no aria-label; the 'Color by' span is not associated with the Segmented (no aria-labelledby).
Chip run status conveyed only by an unlabeled icon + color; no sr-only text/aria-label, so done/running/pending is lost to AT (color-only encoding).
Canvas role=img aria-label is static and never reflects the current color-by mode/gene.

DOUBLE-CONFIRMED (correctness+perf): legend shows count 0 for every cluster because CLUSTERS[i].count is populated only as a side-effect of mockCells() run inside ExplorerCanvas's post-paint effect (mutates a plain array, no React update). On the clustered gallery seed the legend renders before/without the mutation → 0 counts; breaks the clustered Layer-B snapshot.

Dock bypasses prerequisite gating: it renders all recipe plugins as runnable chips and run() (store:87) has no availability() guard, so a user can open+Run UMAP (requires reduced) before PCA. Gating exists only in the catalog's disabled state.
Gene-not-found is a silent dead-end: ColorByControl accepts any gene string; an unknown gene → geneCluster()=null → whole scatter painted neutral at alpha 0.18 (near-invisible) with no feedback.

No no-results empty-state: a search matching no plugin renders every group null → blank scroll area. The placeholder actively suggests 'trajectory', which matches ZERO registered plugins → typing the suggested term yields a silent blank.
Hand-rolled <table> reimplements kit Table (also <th> lack scope). Use kit Table.
KPI tiles hand-rolled, reimplementing kit Statistic. Reuse Statistic.
Upload drop-zone hand-rolled (dashed div + disabled Button) instead of kit Upload (disabled) which provides the drop-zone + a11y.
Mobile: ContextPanel is placed inside a Sheet with title='Analysis' while ContextPanel renders its OWN header+close X → duplicated header + two close affordances.
ContextPanel hardcodes 'border-l' (right-column styling) which is wrong inside the mobile bottom Sheet.

At ~390px the floating top overlay (Color-by label + 3-opt Segmented + gene input + Color button + Export) flex-wraps into several rows, occluding most of the small canvas; the w-44 legend overlay compounds it.
QC section is an ad-hoc bold heading in a bare div (not Card/SectionHeader), inconsistent with the DatasetsPanel precedent and with the upload block in the same panel which IS Card-framed.
finish() unconditionally overrides colorBy.mode from result.colorMode on every completed run, clobbering a user's explicit color-by choice on re-run/recipe-step-complete.
geneDraft is init-only useState; external colorBy.gene changes (study switch, gene demo) don't update the input → desync.

setParams calls draftFor(id) inside the set() updater, and draftFor itself calls set() when the draft is missing — a nested set() dispatched from within another set()'s updater; fragile, inner update can be dropped.

Copy 'Running in the sandbox…' asserts real execution during the mock simulation; 'Reproducible · seed 0' (ResultCard:78) claims reproducibility on canned data; ExportMenu:27 'prepared' implies ready. Misleading for an interface-only round.
Local useIsMobile reimplements kit useIsMobile with a different breakpoint (820 vs 768). Use the kit hook or justify the threshold.
RangeField omits the optional testid, so advanced range inputs (MADs, min-genes, resolution) are untestable — inconsistent with the other Field kinds which auto-derive a testid.
Redundant resize wiring: ResizeObserver + window 'resize' both call schedule(); the window listener is superfluous.
Footer '4 samples' is hardcoded while QC_SAMPLES.length is the real source; drifts if the list changes.
Scatter scaling has no guard for tiny canvas (<2*pad → negative scale) or degenerate data (maxX===minX → div0). Not reachable with seeded data but unguarded.
recipeRunning guards only re-entry of runStandardRecipe; individual run() calls (dock/Run button) are not blocked during a recipe → concurrent runs possible.

useInstantMock sets __ANALYSIS_MOCK_INSTANT__ for EVERY spec, so run() short-circuits to finish() and the running/progress UI (analysis-run-progress/analysis-progress-bar) is NEVER exercised — TEST-8's 'live progress' claim and ITEM-6/DEC-11 visible-progress requirement have zero real-path coverage.
TEST-3 claims chips transition queued→running→done but asserts only terminal done; the store has no 'queued' state (pending|running|done). Phantom transition leg + wrong vocabulary in TESTS.md.

TEST-8 [covers ITEM-3,6,8] asserts only result-card + provenance toggle; never asserts KPIs, never asserts progress, and cannot assert canvas-reflection (qc.filter has no colorMode). ITEM-8 canvas + ITEM-3 engine legs are phantom (coverage inflation).

TEST-7 claims Leiden's resolution control + named advanced fields, but the spec opens qc.filter and asserts only the generic form/advanced-panel show/hide; never mounts Leiden, never asserts a resolution control or named advanced field.
TEST-4 claims 'typing a gene recolors' but asserts only input value + canvas visible (opaque canvas) → proves 'no crash', not recolor. Claim overstates.
TEST-13 claims 'the dock scrolls' but asserts only no-x-overflow + bottom-sheet; dock-scroll never asserted.
NO scope-drift: all 12 PLAN items implemented with file evidence; upload/export stubs are DEC-permitted. Catalog, progressive disclosure, QC advisory all present + real.
No fetch/http/eval/dangerouslySetInnerHTML/secrets/localStorage; canEdit gates Run/Add/Export-write; viewers read-only. Clean.
All lists bounded: 768 mock cells memoized, marker table fixed 6 rows, catalog 8 plugins, dock ≤8 chips, 4 QC cards. No fetch-all/render-all.
